summary: Same retrieval, plus two cross-encoders and a set-wise transformer that scores all 50 candidates jointly instead of one at a time. ~0.95 NDCG@10.
blocked_on: No serving artifact exists. listwise_ranker_v2.py produces out-of-fold ranked lists only (it never calls torch.save), and its two cross-encoder inputs are precomputed OOF CSVs (ce_scores_v5ce_bge.csv, ce_scores_v5ce_gte.csv), not a live scorer. Serving this tier needs three things: (1) fit the set-wise model on all queries and torch.save it, (2) run the cross-encoders live over the 50-candidate pool, (3) write the same response builder. Until then the 0.9508 is an offline evaluation, not a service.
stages: retrieval (shared with lightweight: BM25 + dense -> RRF -> 50 candidates)
set-wise transformer over the full 50-candidate set (listwise_ranker_v2.py)
